segments.english:
10873—Umayma bint Abi al-Haytham ibn al-Tayyihan, the Ansari woman.³

Her father was mentioned previously. Abu Ja'far ibn Habib mentioned her among the women of the Ansar who pledged allegiance to the Prophet—may Allah bless him and grant him peace. Ibn Sa'd said: Her mother was Mulayka bint Sahl. She embraced Islam and pledged allegiance, according to the narration of Muhammad ibn Umar.

(1) al-Isti'ab, entry 3288.
(2) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6741.
(3) Usd al-Ghaba, entry 6746.
